gbm_population_evidence.quote: Radiographic evidence of a GAD-enhancing intra-axial tumor consistent with HGG;

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients undergoing surgery for first-time diagnosis of high grade glioma (HGG)

coder_notes: Surgical trial (supramarginal vs conventional resection); no drug interventions. Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels (only 'mRANO ... Glioblastoma' in outcomes), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Registered phase NA. The OTHER-type arm 'Conventional (i.e. GTR) resection' functions as the control. Gadolinium is used for MRI only and is not a registered intervention, so not listed.
